brief: @buildthis.bisks.net please create a browser based vocoder from a user's mic input. Let them use the keys on their computer keyboard to set the root notes, and please support polyphony. Give it a cheesy 50's sci-fi styling.
note: built a live browser vocoder: mic in as modulator, your keyboard plays a polyphonic carrier — hold a chord and it sings it. dressed it up as a 1950s sci-fi control panel, oscilloscope and all.
